trust_decision.summary: Which provider method a dashboard user may run by name (with the channel's stored token as first argument) is decided in IntegrationsController.functionIntegration; at the pinned commit the only check is that the property is truthy, so any prototype method (including protected media helpers that readFileSync a path) is callable.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'unrestricted provider method calls'; the only by-name dispatch in the dashboard API is integrationProvider[body.name](...) in POST /integrations/function.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: apps/backend/src/api/routes/integrations.controller.ts:312 (POST /mentions calls this.functionIntegration(org, body) with the caller's body.name; fix pins name to 'mention')

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once /integrations/function is allowlisted, /mentions looks safe because it goes through the same function; and the third-party /third-party/function/:id/:functionName route belongs to a separate 'third-party integrations' feature whose providers have no file-reading helpers.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The dashboard legitimately calls non-@Tool provider helpers by name (pages, companies, company, tags, mention); an allowlist that admits only @Tool methods, or a denylist-free 'block everything', breaks channel page selection, LinkedIn company lookup, Hashnode tags and editor mentions.

O6_input_shapes: body.name naming an inherited/protected prototype method (e.g. media read helpers on SocialAbstract)
body.name naming a public non-@Tool method that is legitimate (must stay allowed via @DashboardFunction)
body.name naming a non-function property or Object.prototype member (fix requires typeof === 'function' plus allowlist)
body.name sent via POST /mentions instead of /function (fix overrides to 'mention')
subclass override of an allowlisted base method (fix comment: metadata keyed per method name so overrides stay callable)

O7_producer.where: Allowlist data comes from decorator metadata: getAllTools reads 'custom:tool' at libraries/nestjs-libraries/src/integrations/integration.manager.ts:151-167; no schema/serializer/cache produces the method name.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /third-party/function/:id/:functionName runs thirdPartyInstance.instance[functionName](decryptedApiKey, body) with no allowlist; same by-name dispatch on a separate provider family.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different feature (third-party media/video integrations, not social channels) and its providers (heygen, reelfarm, hubspot) contain no fs reads, so the advisory's file-read impact does not apply there.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different controller in apps/backend; providers in libraries/nestjs-libraries/src/3rdparties/ (separate manager)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: processPlugs dispatches integration[getPlugById.plugFunction] from a DB value stored unvalidated by POST /integrations/:id/plugs (libraries/nestjs-libraries/src/database/prisma/integrations/integration.repository.ts:930-945); at pinned commit it is only safe because checkPlugs filters by @Plug metadata before scheduling (libraries/nestjs-libraries/src/database/prisma/posts/posts.service.ts:866-870).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A save/reload sibling: dropping or bypassing the checkPlugs filter (e.g. a 'run plug now' path or a manual reschedule) is a plausible maintainer change, and the check is far from the producer (DTO accepts any func string, libraries/nestjs-libraries/src/dtos/plugs/plug.dto.ts:14-17).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Internal-plug dispatch getSocialIntegration[getAllInternalPlugs.methodName] is allowlisted by 'custom:internal_plug' metadata; a variant that takes methodName from the stored trigger information instead would reopen the sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same dispatch idiom, data already flows through the workflow payload (data.information).

O9_family: Unsafe reflection / externally controlled method name (CWE-470) reaching file read (CWE-73)

O10_build.toolchain: Node 22.23.4, pnpm 10.6.1, NestJS, jest (root package.json scripts.test)
O10_build.project_tests: No *.spec.ts / *.test.ts under apps/ or libraries/ at the pinned commit; jest is configured but there are no tests for this area. Hidden tests would need to unit-test IntegrationsController.functionIntegration / IntegrationManager with mocked IntegrationService.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reuse the @Tool allowlist from the public API (public.integrations.controller.ts:706-716), which breaks pages/company/tags/mention, or denylist the fs helpers (readOrFetch/mediaStream) and leave every other prototype method callable.
